metrics.description: Provides a verifiable report of the variable state at every stage of execution for debugging and compliance, ensuring that any data-related failure can be traced back to its specific definition point.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Audit Completeness % = (Variable state transitions logged and traceable / Total DU pairs) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: >= 90% of DU pairs have traceable execution audit record

metrics.description: Rate of code change (lines added + deleted) over a rolling window; high churn signals instability and elevated regression risk
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Churn = (Lines Added + Lines Deleted) / Total LOC over rolling 30-day window
metrics.expected_threshold: < 30% churn per sprint; flag modules with > 50%

metrics.description: Isolates specific modules that have undergone recent modifications, allowing QA to focus regression suites only on affected areas to prevent existing features from breaking during updates.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Regression Coverage % = (High-Churn Modules in Regression Suite / Total High-Churn Modules) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of modules with churn > 30% included in regression suite

metrics.description: Uses historical churn data to predict where future bugs will likely occur, measuring the correlation between high change volume and defect density as an early warning system for unstable modules.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Fault Probability Score = Churn% × Defect_Density (bugs per KLOC) over rolling 30-day window

metrics.description: Identifies when code has changed so significantly that existing test cases are likely outdated or irrelevant, signaling when tests need to be rewritten to maintain accuracy.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Stale Test % = (Test Files not updated despite source churn > 20% / Total Test Files) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: < 5% of test files stale relative to churned source modules

metrics.description: Measures the ripple effect of a code change by identifying all connected modules that may be affected, helping developers understand the full scope before merging to prevent unintended consequences.
metrics.derivation: side_effect_scope = sum(len(file.changed_methods) for file in modified_files)

metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of downstream impacted modules included in test run
